concept_search_indexes: The database indexes documented in SEARCH_OPTIMIZATION.md that speed up full-text and filtered search queries.
concept_search_rate_limiting: The rate limiting applied to search API endpoints, documented in SEARCH_OPTIMIZATION.md, to prevent abuse of search and translation lookups.
concept_theme_release_upgrade: The documented workflow in THEME_ARCHITECTURE.md for releasing and upgrading theme packages.
concept_theme_resolution_precedence: The order of precedence documented in THEME_ARCHITECTURE.md by which the active theme is resolved (e.g. capability, site setting, config default).
concept_user_form_tabs: A tabbed layout added to the admin user-management form, documented in IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md.
concept_valuation_workflow_transitions: The set of allowed status transitions for a valuation record, defined in the real estate valuations API's OpenAPI spec.
concept_vendor_decision: The CONFORMANCE.md decision (§3.2) that the Composer vendor namespace remains liberusoftware/ across all packages.
concept_vendor_naming_decision: A recorded decision in a conformance-map handoff weighing 'liberusoftware' against 'liberu' as the Composer vendor prefix.
concept_versioned_real_estate_api_namesp: The /api/v1/real-estate URL namespace documented in the real-estate-properties-api README under which the real-estate API endpoints are versioned.
concept_wayfinder_map_612: GitHub issue #612, the 'Wayfinder map' tracking issue referenced in a conformance handoff for coordinating child conformance tickets.
config_database: database.php, the Laravel configuration file defining database connections and their credentials for the host application.
config_jetstream: jetstream.php, the Laravel Jetstream configuration file controlling teams, profile photos, and related feature toggles.
config_modules: modules.php, the module-manager package's configuration file holding the MODULES_ENABLED/MODULES_DISABLED environment-driven overrides.
config_services: services.php, the Laravel configuration file holding third-party service credentials (e.g. mail, social login, translation providers).
conformance_step_5_test_redistribution: Conformance Step 5, documented in a dated handoff, covering the redistribution of tests out of the host and into their owning packages.
contracts_integrationadapter: IntegrationAdapter.php, a contract in the integrations module defining capabilities(), name(), and test() methods that third-party integration adapters must implement.
contracts_onthemarkettransport: OnTheMarketTransport.php, a contract in the real-estate-onthemarket module defining the transport methods (branchPropertyList, removeProperty, sendProperty) an OnTheMarket API adapter must implement.
contracts_rightmovetransport: RightmoveTransport.php, a contract in the real-estate-rightmove module defining the transport methods (branchPropertyList, removeProperty, sendProperty) a Rightmove API adapter must implement.
contracts_searchindexer: SearchIndexer.php, a contract in the search module defining index(), remove(), and flush() methods that a search-indexing backend must implement.
contracts_settingdefinition: SettingDefinition.php, a contract in the settings module defining key(), secret(), and validate() methods for declaring a configurable application setting.
contracts_zooplatransport: ZooplaTransport.php, a contract in the real-estate-zoopla module defining the transport methods (branchPropertyList, removeProperty, sendProperty) a Zoopla API adapter must implement.
controllers_branchcontroller: BranchController.php, the HTTP controller in real-estate-core-api handling API requests for agency branches.
controllers_marketingcampaigncontroller: MarketingCampaignController.php, the HTTP controller in real-estate-marketing-api handling API requests for marketing campaigns.
controllers_partycontroller: PartyController.php, the HTTP controller in real-estate-parties-api handling API requests for party (contact) records.
controllers_portalreportcontroller: PortalReportController.php, the HTTP controller in real-estate-portals-reporting-api handling API requests for portal sync reports.
controllers_salesprogressioncontroller: SalesProgressionController.php, the HTTP controller in real-estate-sales-progression-api handling API requests for sales progression records.
core_module_index: The core module index in modules/core/README.md, listing the one-core-package-per-adapter capability boundaries across the Liberu and Real Estate projects.
delivery_phase_2: Delivery phase 2 of the real estate project roadmap, covering sales progression, portals, marketing, reporting, and documents capabilities, documented in projects/real-estate/REAL-ESTATE.md.
discovery_themediscovery_themediscovery: ThemeDiscovery, a class in the theme-support module that discovers available theme packages by merging the tracked themes/ directory with Composer-installed liberu-theme packages.
doc_agents_domain: The Agent Domain Docs Convention documented in docs/agents/domain.md, describing the single-context CONTEXT.md/docs/adr/ documentation approach for agents.
doc_agents_issue_tracker: The Agent Issue Tracker Convention documented in docs/agents/issue-tracker.md, describing how agents use GitHub Issues to track work.
doc_gemini_md: GEMINI.md, a repository root document providing Gemini-CLI-specific guidance analogous to CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md.
entity_contract_packages: The small contract packages (liberusoftware/analytics-contracts, liberusoftware/localization-contracts) documented in CLAUDE.md that give adapter implementations independence via shared interfaces.
entity_module_json: module.json, the manifest file each package ships declaring its provider class, capabilities, dependencies, default_enabled flag, and Filament plugin classes.
entity_module_validator: ModuleValidator, the CLAUDE.md-documented class that validates module manifests and fails the boot with a clear error when a package is misconfigured or not installed.
entity_theme_real_estate_default: theme-real-estate-default, a Liberu theme package providing the default visual theme for the Real Estate host application.
feature_realestateofferstest: RealEstateOffersTest.php, a Feature test in tests/Feature covering the real-estate offers module's behavior.
feature_realestatepropertyactionstest: RealEstatePropertyActionsTest.php, a Feature test in tests/Feature covering property-related actions in the real-estate properties module.
feature_realestatevaluationstest: RealEstateValuationsTest.php, a Feature test in tests/Feature covering the real-estate valuations module's behavior.
feature_realestateviewingstest: RealEstateViewingsTest.php, a Feature test in tests/Feature covering the real-estate viewings module's behavior.
